LESSON: MIRACLE OF HEALING

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.4: Miracle of Healing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Miracle of Healing, part of The Life of Jesus Christ in Grade 6 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: How did the bleeding woman portray faith in God?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. describe the miracle of healing the bleeding woman,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Miracle of Healing in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Miracle of Healing in the Kenya CBC curriculum.

   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: the skill of speaking clearly and effectively is enhanced as learners discuss ways the

church and government are helping the sick in the society.

• Creativity and imagination: the skill of originality is enhanced as learners compose and sing a song about God’s healing

power.

Values:
• Integrity: learners display honesty as learnt from the healing of the bleeding woman.

• Love: learners demonstrate a caring attitude towards sick people in society as demonstrated by Jesus Christ.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Health promotion issues are enhanced as they learn the importance of being in good health.

Links to other Learning Areas:
• Creative Arts: creative skills are applied as learners compose and sing songs.

• English: communication skills are enhanced as learners read Luke 8:43-48 and retell the miracle.
